description:
Trending Shorts: the short videos (TikToks, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) rising
    now on a subject, fastest first. Each item has video_id, platform, url, cover_url,
    creator, caption, plays, posted_at, age_hours, plays_per_hour (plays over the hours
    since posting, at least one), multiple and multiple_basis (plays over the creator's
    usual: the median of their latest videos, or TikTok likes per video; null when it could
    not be measured), creator_usual, duration_s, and spoken_hook with spoken_hook_from (the
    opening line when one of your own Short form runs delivered the video, or Scribe v2
    heard it). At most 20 items, 2 per creator; a video with no post date is never listed.
    unavailable names a platform whose search did not answer. Free (credits_charged 0); the
    same subject, platform and window within 30 minutes is served from the cache, and fresh
    fetches are limited per account per hour (429 rate_limited). 503 search_unavailable
    when no platform answered. Needs read. Same as GET /v1/shorts/trending.

platform.description: tiktok, instagram or youtube; leave out for all three
platform.title: Platform

subject.description: what the videos are about, 2 to 120 characters
subject.title: Subject

window.description: 24h, 7d (default) or 30d: how recently they were posted
window.title: Window

name: trending_shorts
